mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy, reducing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals aggressive monetary easing with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases by > 100,000 in a month and 5-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and Real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% YoY, the combined signal indicates strong economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% YoY and GDPC1 > 2% YoY
failure_condition: If HOUST increases > 10% YoY and GDPC1 > 2% YoY and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals a weakening supply side, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
